corrections: (1) Prevalence of crash/render recovery is 4 of 5, not 3: buzz also has a root React error boundary that shows a 'Buzz failed to start' screen with a Reload button (desktop/src/app/RootErrorBoundary.tsx). That makes it table stakes. QM: none found. (2) The Teams hang toast has Wait / Trace / Restart. desktop.json has no Reload button string. (3) The Teams error curtain is a native-shell screen for when the web client fails to start. It is not a render/chunk error boundary.
